display_name: 客户流失多轮进化演示
data_schema: Deterministic synthetic customer churn dataset with 12 numerical features, a customer_id, and a binary churned target. Candidate processes receive 2,400 training rows and 600 sealed-holdout feature rows; review labels are kept outside the candidate data directory.
extra_notes: Product-demo campaign only. Execute exactly eight bounded local CPU candidates through the normal sandbox runner. Results are real public-validation and sealed synthetic holdout metrics, never MLE-Bench, Kaggle, SIIM private-grader, rank, or medal evidence.
